I am farming here in Manyara on my own land, and the rains can be tricky, so I must be careful with money. I will put some small manure from my cattle on the maize because it helps the soil, and I intercrop with beans as usual. Chemical fertilizer is expensive and I only buy a little if I can afford it; this year I will try a small amount of urea for top-dressing. I will use the seed I saved from last year because hybrid seed costs too much, and I depend on my wife and children for most of the work.
